posts.title: The new GPT-5.6 family: Luna, Terra, Sol
posts.author: Simon Willison
posts.summary:
OpenAI's latest flagship model hit general availability this morning, and comes in three sizes: Luna, Terra, and Sol (from smallest to largest).

The new models are priced per 1M input/output tokens as Luna $1/$6, Terra $2.50/$15, Sol $5/$30....
